verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a reconciliation process, ledger-to-bank-core matching, or any daily reconciliation reporting mechanism — only vague references to 'complete data visibility' and general product features (customer/card/transfer APIs). Given the sponsor-bank model risk highlighted by Synapse's collapse, this is a fair and material axis for a BaaS platform, but no concrete evidence shows Synctera documents or automates ledger reconciliation with bank partners.
